model_name: CarePath AI Adolescent Elevated HbA1c Screening Prototype
version: Logistic Regression candidate; fitted on full reconstructed adolescent cohort
cohort_definition: Participants aged 12-17 with DIQ010 == 2 (reported no previous diabetes diagnosis) and available HbA1c (LBXGH).
target: Elevated HbA1c: LBXGH >= 5.7%; screening-range label, not a diabetes diagnosis.

evaluation.method: Repeated stratified 5-fold cross-validation repeated 5 times; internal resampling. Metrics carried over from the previously generated adolescent evaluation.

prediction_semantics.predict: Uses scikit-learn default class decision rule.
prediction_semantics.predict_proba: Returns model scores/probabilities; not established as calibrated clinical risks.
prediction_semantics.threshold_status: No clinically selected threshold; the default predict decision is a software default only.

limitations: Experimental research prototype; not a clinical decision tool and not a diagnosis.
Discrimination is weak (reported ROC-AUC 0.5570); reported precision is low (0.0831).
Repeated cross-validation is internal resampling, not independent external validation.
Pipeline was fitted on all 704 records after CV for handoff; this full-cohort fit is not an independent test evaluation.
NHANES is a United States sample; performance and suitability in Malaysia, Abu Dhabi, or other populations have not been established.
Scoped only to ages 12-17 and the stated six features; do not use for children under 12 or adults.
There were 50 participants with HbA1c 5.7% to below 6.5% and none at or above 6.5%; do not describe the positive target as adolescent diabetes.
source_file_note: DBQ_L and PAQY_L were included in the source merge but are not model predictors.
